description: The one outcome contract and the one producer of result text for the merged messaging tools. 'outcomes' carries every outcome with the four vocabulary columns (mayHaveBeenTransmitted, terminal, reuseMessageId are reproduced verbatim from internal/messaging/testdata/outcome_vocabulary.json for source 'messaging'), the result fields the outcome carries, and its render template per action. 'matrix' is the action-by-outcome table: every pair listed here must have a non-empty template and is exercised by at least one conformance case (TestOutcomeRenderTotal). peers_rename is the peers rename row's key. 'peers_last' carries the four templates for the peers last action, which reports no outcome. Templates carry no literal quotes: facts arrive pre-quoted, exactly as internal/messaging.Repair takes them.

render.withdraw: ask {message_id} was already answered; nothing was withdrawn

render.ask: no reply to {message_id} from {target} before the timeout; withdraw it with avenor_message action="withdraw" message_id={message_id}
render.reply: reply to {message_id} was not delivered before the timeout; nothing is pending
render.withdraw: ask {message_id} timed out; nothing was withdrawn

render.ask: no ask {message_id} is pending on {target}; nothing is pending
render.reply: no ask {message_id} is pending on this surface; nothing was sent
render.withdraw: no ask {message_id} is pending; nothing was withdrawn

render.tell: message {message_id} to {target} was rejected (not authorized); nothing is pending
render.ask: ask {message_id} to {target} was rejected (not authorized); nothing is pending
render.reply: reply to {message_id} was rejected (not authorized); nothing is pending

render.tell: message {message_id} not sent to {target}; nothing is pending
render.ask: ask {message_id} was not sent to {target}; nothing is pending
render.reply: reply to {message_id} was not sent; nothing is pending
render.withdraw: withdrawal of {message_id} was not sent; nothing is pending

render.tell: message {message_id} to {target} may still be pending; if no reply arrives, withdraw it with avenor_message action="withdraw" message_id={message_id}
render.ask: ask {message_id} to {target} may still be pending; if no reply arrives, withdraw it with avenor_message action="withdraw" message_id={message_id}
render.reply: reply to {message_id} may still be pending
render.withdraw: ask {message_id} may still be pending; retry avenor_message action="withdraw" message_id={message_id}

render.ask: ask {message_id} to {target} is lost and cannot be withdrawn; nothing is pending
render.reply: reply to {message_id} is lost; nothing was sent
render.withdraw: ask {message_id} is lost; nothing was withdrawn

peers_last.empty: run {run_id} has no completed turn yet
peers_last.no_text: run {run_id} finished (stop reason: {stop_reason}) with no final text
